name: server-manager
description: 科研多 GPU 服务器调度台

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sm/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sm/shared && npm run build -w @sm/server && npm run build -w @sm/mcp && npm run build -w @sm/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/server packages/mcp && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
